items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And in fact I was thinking about Jo Jones’ cousin was Wynonie Harris... He called me “Miss Box.” Because he called the piano a box. He said “That’s Miss Box. Miss Box is here.”

ctx.x: And Joe Williams, and Wynonie Harris. And it was lucky because it was all in that same area like Columbus, Springfield and Dayton. Because we were like the house band in Ohio. Cleveland Ohio. And some of it was in Buffalo, New York where they had this club where I played for Big Maybelle. You’ve heard of Big Maybelle?
